derived_from.hypothesis: The picker is told scarcity matters, which is correct and is also the instruction most likely to be over-learned. A picker that never picks passes every restraint case in the suite and scores clean while the feature silently does nothing forever, and because a standout fires roughly monthly, months of silence is indistinguishable from months of nothing qualifying. Nothing else in the system would notice. This case is the other half of standout_declines_when_the_journal_says_not_to and exists so that a clean 0/N cannot be mistaken for working restraint.

intent: When a genuinely decisive record is on the table, pick something. Silence is the normal answer, not the only permitted one.

judge_assertions.name: prefers_the_decisive_candidate
judge_assertions.statement: The stated reason for the choice rests on the size of the improvement or the depth of the history behind it, and does not justify the pick by appeal to encouraging the person, to their goals needing motivation, or to it being the only remaining option.

notes: The journal is deliberately unremarkable, so nothing licenses a decline. Both candidates clear the production gates, so this scores whether the picker fires at all rather than how finely it discriminates. Values, populations and spans come from the operator profile's real seven-year history; the dates are shifted forward so the fixture reads as something that just happened. Synthetic rather than a regression: call 1944 is a real standout call whose shape the fixture copies, as the convention for synthetic cases requires, but it succeeded — the failure this pins was found by this case, not captured from production.
